nodes.description: Hard-coded address of the SDC ERC20 token contract (0xe85e...95c5).
Hard-coded privileged admin address allowed to lock funds (0x34e0...3245).
TokenERC20 interface instance pointing at sdcContractAddr; used for outbound token transfers.
mapping(address=>accountInputSdc[]) public: per-user list of locked-token deposits with locktime and creation time.
mapping(address=>accountOutputSdc[]) public: per-user list of withdrawal records.
mapping(address=>accoutInputOutputSdcLog[]) public: append-only audit log of lock/unlock operations.
mapping(address=>uint) public: running balance of unlocked (claimable) SDC per user.
Admin-only function that registers a locked SDC deposit for a user after checking msg.sender == sdcMainAcc.
User withdrawal: matures expired deposits into unlockSdc, then transfers tokens to msg.sender and decrements unlockSdc.
Constant helper returning block.timestamp (now).
Constant view returning the caller's number of input (locked) records.
Constant view returning the caller's number of output (withdrawal) records.
Constant view summing still-locked SDC amounts (now < locktime) for the caller.
Constant view summing available SDC (unlockSdc plus matured deposits) for the caller.
Public function that matures the caller's expired deposits into unlockSdc, mutating storage with no access restriction.
Payable fallback function; accepts plain Ether transfers with an empty body.
Caller-supplied address used for authorization checks, mapping indexing and as transfer recipient.
Block timestamp exposed via the 'now' keyword; used for locktime comparisons and record timestamps.
sdcCon.transfer(msg.sender,_sdc): external call to an attacker-influenced token contract performed before state is settled.
unlockSdc[msg.sender] = unlockSdc[msg.sender] + accountInputSdcs[msg.sender][i].sdc in outSdcForUser (unchecked overflow).
unlockSdc[msg.sender] = unlockSdc[msg.sender] - _sdc executed after the external transfer in outSdcForUser.
unlockSdc[msg.sender] += accountInputSdcs[msg.sender][i].sdc in insetMoney (unchecked overflow, no auth).
_address: beneficiary of the admin lock in inSdcForAdmin.
_sdc: locked token amount in inSdcForAdmin.
_locktime: unlock timestamp in inSdcForAdmin.
_sdc: withdrawal amount in outSdcForUser.
Loop index 'i' iterating over accountInputSdcs[msg.sender] in outSdcForUser, getLockSdc, getUnlockSdc and insetMoney.
tmpLockSdc accumulator in getLockSdc.
tmpUnlockSdc accumulator in getUnlockSdc.

edges.reason: sdcCon is constructed from the hard-coded sdcContractAddr token address.
The external token transfer is invoked on the sdcCon interface instance.
inSdcForAdmin requires msg.sender == sdcMainAcc, gating the whole lock path on the hard-coded admin account.
User-controlled msg.sender is the subject of the require(msg.sender == sdcMainAcc) authorization check.
_address parameter is stored in the new accountInputSdc record for accountInputSdcs[_address].
_sdc parameter amount is written into accountInputSdcs[_address].
_locktime parameter is written into accountInputSdcs[_address] and controls future maturity.
block.timestamp (now) is recorded as createttime in the input record, creating time dependence.
The same deposit is mirrored into the accoutInputOutputSdcLogs audit trail.
outSdcForUser drives all loops and mapping lookups from the caller-supplied msg.sender.
In outSdcForUser maturity is decided by now >= accountInputSdcs[msg.sender][i].locktime, a timestamp dependency miners can influence.
accountInputSdcs[msg.sender][i].sdc is summed into the unlock balance.
Current unlockSdc[msg.sender] is read as the left operand of the addition.
Result of the unchecked addition is written back into unlockSdc[msg.sender].
_sdc parameter controls the withdrawal amount in outSdcForUser.
require(unlockSdc[msg.sender] >= _sdc) makes the unlock balance gate the external transfer.
msg.sender is passed as the transfer recipient of the external token call.
_sdc is passed as the value argument of the external token transfer.
The external call into the token contract can re-enter outSdcForUser (or insetMoney) before unlockSdc and the logs are updated.
unlockSdc[msg.sender] is read as the operand of the post-transfer subtraction.
_sdc is subtracted from unlockSdc, so a stale balance after reentrancy can underflow/overstate withdrawals.
Subtraction result is written back to unlockSdc[msg.sender] only after the external call returns.
Withdrawal record accountOutputSdcs[msg.sender].push uses caller identity.
nowInSeconds returns block.timestamp directly, exposing the clock to external consumers.
getAccountInputSdcslength returns the array length for the caller-supplied msg.sender.
getAccountOutputSdcslength returns the array length for the caller-supplied msg.sender.
getLockSdc iterates the caller's accountInputSdcs entries.
getLockSdc classification depends on now < accountInputSdcs[msg.sender][i].locktime.
Locked amounts for the caller are read from accountInputSdcs.
Each unexpired deposit amount is accumulated into the tmpLockSdc local.
tmpLockSdc is returned as the result of getLockSdc.
getUnlockSdc reads unlockSdc[msg.sender] for the caller-supplied address.
getUnlockSdc sums entries where now >= accountInputSdcs[msg.sender][i].locktime, a timestamp dependency.
unlockSdc[msg.sender] seeds the tmpUnlockSdc accumulator.
Initial unlock balance is loaded into the tmpUnlockSdc local.
tmpUnlockSdc is returned as the result of getUnlockSdc.
insetMoney is callable by any address and operates entirely on msg.sender's mapping entries.
insetMoney matures deposits based on now >= accountInputSdcs[msg.sender][i].locktime.
Expired accountInputSdcs amounts are summed into the caller's unlock balance.
Existing unlockSdc[msg.sender] is read as the addition operand in insetMoney.
Unchecked addition result is written back to unlockSdc[msg.sender], and the record is then zeroed with locktime 999999999999.
Loop index i indexes accountInputSdcs[msg.sender] and is also reused to write back a zeroed record.
The payable fallback can receive Ether from any caller; no state is updated and no funds are routed.

normalization_plan.reason: _address is only a formal parameter of inSdcForAdmin and should be folded into that function node.
_sdc (in lock amount) is only a formal parameter of inSdcForAdmin and should be folded into that function node.
_locktime is only a formal parameter of inSdcForAdmin and should be folded into that function node.
_sdc (withdrawal amount) is only a formal parameter of outSdcForUser and should be folded into that function node.
Loop index i is a transient local used inside outSdcForUser (and peer view functions) and should be folded into the enclosing function node.
tmpLockSdc is a local accumulator whose only purpose is to produce the return value of getLockSdc.
tmpUnlockSdc is a local accumulator whose only purpose is to produce the return value of getUnlockSdc.
